title: HappEats Dry Fruits & Healthy Snacks
headline: A joyful, scalable packaging architecture for healthy snack retail.
description: HappEats committed to delivering the finest quality healthy snacks with a touch of joy. challenge: Create a premium, scalable packaging system for a diverse dry fruits range that improves retail shelf visibility, communicates ingredient purity, and maintains unmistakable brand recall across both 100gm pouches and 25gm grab-and-go packs.

title: Strategic Targeting & Psychographic Ad Architecture
headline: Right Message. Right People. Real Results. — The science of purchasing decision-makers.
description: A landmark proprietary case study from AFTER THAT's agency playbook demonstrating the transformative power of audience segmentation. Shifting anti-snoring product messaging from generic user features to the actual frustrated partner resulted in a 4x surge in qualified orders and CTR.
challenge: Overcome low click-through and customer apathy caused by generic product-centric advertisements in commoditized consumer healthcare.
approach: We dissected the decision chain: the person with the condition is rarely motivated to buy; the spouse losing sleep has the urgency. By retargeting married partners ('No more sleepless nights because of his snoring'), the campaign established instant empathy and clear action.
deliverables: 5-Part Advertisement Formula (Audience, Problem, Promise, Proof, Action)
Creative Ad Split Testing (Generic vs. Strategic)
